title: From mechanism to intervention: lipoproteins and Alzheimer’s disease
title_zh: 从机制到干预：脂蛋白与阿尔茨海默病
abstract: Abstract Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the leading global cause of dementia, characterized by memory impairment and neuropathological hallmarks of amyloid and tau deposition. Several cardiovascular risk factors, including hypertension, type II diabetes, and dyslipidemia, are modifiable risk factors of AD, especially during midlife, highlighting a close interplay between AD and vascular contributions to cognitive impairment and dementia (VCID). The objectives of this narrative review are to: (1) synthesize recent literature, mainly from 2024 to 2026, on how lipoproteins, namely apolipoprotein E (ApoE), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C), influence risk of AD and related dementias (ADRD), (2) describe mechanisms by which lipoproteins may contribute to ADRD and VCID risk, and (3) highlight potential interventions that involve lipoprotein metabolism with a focus on cholesteryl ester transfer protein (CETP), which regulates LDL-C and HDL-C levels in humans. Interest in CETP as a potential therapeutic target in dementia is surging, as a new and well-tolerated CETP inhibitor obicetrapib was recently found to slow progression of plasma p-tau-217, an approved diagnostic biomarker of amyloid positivity, over 12 months of treatment in patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, with more pronounced effects in APOE4 carriers.
abstract_zh: 摘要 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是全球痴呆症的主要原因，表现为记忆障碍和淀粉样蛋白与tau蛋白沉积的神经病理特征。多种心血管风险因素，包括高血压、II型糖尿病和血脂异常，都是可调节的AD风险因素，尤其在中年阶段，凸显了AD与血管对认知功能障碍和痴呆（VCID）的密切相互作用。本综述的目标是：(1) 综合2024年至2026年的最新文献，主要关注脂蛋白（即载脂蛋白E（ApoE）、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL‑C）和高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（HDL‑C））如何影响AD及相关痴呆（ADRD）的风险；(2) 描述脂蛋白可能通过何种机制增加ADRD和VCID的风险；(3) 强调涉及脂蛋白代谢的潜在干预措施，重点关注胆固醇酯转移蛋白（CETP），该蛋白调节人类LDL‑C和HDL‑C水平。CETP作为痴呆潜在治疗靶点的兴趣日益增长，最近发现一种新型且耐受性良好的CETP抑制剂obicetrapib能够在12个月的治疗中减缓血浆p‑tau‑217（已获批准的淀粉样蛋白阳性诊断生物标志物）的进展，且在APOE4携带者中效果更为显著。
